 When is Veterans Day 2026? Is it a federal holiday? What to know
 Haadiza Ogwude, Cincinnati Enquirer 2026년 10월 28일 수 오후 5:46 UTC 0 Veterans Day , a holiday that honors people who have served in the U.S. military, is nearly here.
 Observed annually on Nov. 11, Veterans Day was originally known as Armistice Day . It initially commemorated World War I veterans but was later expanded to honor all U.S. veterans, whether they served during war or peacetime.
 Here's what to know about Veterans Day and why it is celebrated.
 When is Veterans Day 2026?
 Veterans Day is observed annually on Nov. 11, which falls on a Wednesday this year. 
 Is Veterans Day a federal holiday?
 Nov. 11, previously known as Armistice Day, was established as a federal holiday in 1938 to commemorate the end of World War I, according to History.com . The name was later changed from Armistice Day to Veterans Day on June 1, 1954, when President Dwight D. Eisenhower signed it into law.
 Congress later moved the observance to the fourth Monday in October. In 1975, President Gerald Ford signed legislation returning Veterans Day to Nov. 11. That change went into effect in 1978.
 Do people work on Veterans Day?
 Veterans Day is a federal holiday, which means that many government offices, U.S. banks, financial markets, schools, and some retailers will be closed.
 Advertisement
 Why do we celebrate Veterans Day?
 Veterans Day is a day dedicated to honoring all individuals who served honorably in the U.S. military, in wartime or peacetime, according to the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs . The date coincides with the armistice (or agreement) signed on Nov. 11, 1918, marking the end of World War I.
 The holiday is often marked with parades, family gatherings and public ceremonies at memorial sites and cemeteries.
 When did Veterans Day become a federal holiday?
 Armistice Day became a federal holiday in 1938. Congress renamed it Veterans Day in 1954 to recognize American veterans of all wars.
 What's the difference between Memorial Day and Veterans Day?
 Veterans Day is observed each year on Nov. 11. The holiday celebrates everyone who has served in the U.S. military, while Memorial Day is dedicated to military personnel who died while in service.
 How many federal holidays are left in 2026?
 According to the  U.S. Office of Personnel Management , there are only two federal holidays left in 2026 after Veterans Day.
 Thanksgiving Day:  Thursday, Nov. 26.
 Christmas Day:  Friday, Dec. 25.
 Contributing: Amaris Encinas, USA TODAY.
